name: 1995 Operation Intrude N313 character and story chronology
exact_dates: No canonical full mission clock/duration supplied; sequence order is narrative not hour-by-hour
authoritative_edition: Connect2Media J2ME 3.3.0 a1 still requires event-map dialogue trace

comparative_evidence.claim: 1995 context, Gray Fox disappearance, rookie Snake, Outer Heaven
Transcript, Gray Fox, Madnar, Ellen, boss, Big Boss, ending
Differences between localizations, Steve and later port edits

sequence.event: Gray Fox infiltrates the South African fortress and is lost after his final Metal Gear transmission. Big Boss chooses rookie Snake for Intrude N313.
sequence.dramatic_role: The elite's disappearance makes the rookie assignment ominous; the commander keeps his ownership of the fortress hidden.
sequence.player_beat: Briefing dossier and very short insertion; no invented Gray Fox playable capture chapter.

sequence.event: Snake arrives alone with transceiver, receives rescue and destroy objectives.
sequence.dramatic_role: Initial obedience and isolation, with practical command credibility.
sequence.player_beat: Control rapidly returned; stealth observation before violence.

sequence.event: Snake gets ration/Card 1/binoculars at initial trucks while observing sentry routine.
sequence.dramatic_role: Equipment is earned, not issued; the place presents first moral/survival choices.
sequence.player_beat: Three interactable truck interiors with source progression; no free pistol.

sequence.event: Gas Mask behind Card 1 door; resistance architect offers useful location advice.
sequence.dramatic_role: Schneider becomes trustworthy because what he says can be checked physically.
sequence.player_beat: Optional Schneider call, mandatory gear access defined by actual card state.

sequence.event: Later truck compound offers handgun without initial ammo and land mines.
sequence.dramatic_role: The player cannot simply solve every obstacle by firing.
sequence.player_beat: Visible weapon location and stealth choice.

sequence.event: 3F ammo, prisoners, keycards and further equipment; 2F cameras and security routes. POW information introduces Diane; Steve can answer Japanese-version calls.
sequence.dramatic_role: Unknown allies become differentiated voices: soldier, architect, boss expert.
sequence.player_beat: Use elevators as navigational continuity; no asserted fixed order for optional POW calls.

sequence.event: Prisoners point to Gray Fox's secret solitary cell and suggest capture as the way in.
sequence.dramatic_role: What looks like a mistake becomes an intentional high-risk plan.
sequence.player_beat: Trace source floor and prison entrance before locking corridor map.

sequence.event: Snake is apprehended on the appropriate route; weapons and equipment confiscated.
sequence.dramatic_role: Trusting the mission entails genuine vulnerability.
sequence.player_beat: Capture cinematic no invented escape via menu; actual confiscation persisted.

sequence.event: Snake detects hollow masonry and crosses into Fox's cell.
sequence.dramatic_role: Player solves physical problem and meets the missing elite as a captive.
sequence.player_beat: Sound and visible weakness; no compulsory radio call.

sequence.event: Gray Fox explains nuclear-capable Metal Gear and names Dr. Pettrovich as source of weakness.
sequence.dramatic_role: Experienced operative gives Snake his true mission, with the personal cost of his imprisonment.
sequence.player_beat: Persistent full intel transcript; optional character exchange flagged remake-only.

sequence.event: Recover seized gear and confront Shotmaker/Shoot Gunner defending escape.
sequence.dramatic_role: The prior disarmed protagonist earns the first major combat victory.
sequence.player_beat: No respawn wave; crates and recoverable weapons true to original structure.

sequence.event: Return from prison through upper routes, save further prisoners, access hidden equipment and new keycards.
sequence.dramatic_role: Fox's intel carries forward despite his departure.
sequence.player_beat: Maintain return navigation and POW state.

sequence.event: Machinegun Kid dominates a defended line; player finds angle/cover solution.
sequence.dramatic_role: Boss-specific learned counterplay replaces hit-point inflation.
sequence.player_beat: Distinct suppression telegraph and credible post.

sequence.event: Roof route, parachute and Hind D helicopter confrontation.
sequence.dramatic_role: From building security to militarized air defense.
sequence.player_beat: Helicopter functional threat, not named invented pilot biography.

sequence.event: Tank engagement and disguise checkpoint; commander and architect offer practical access tips.
sequence.dramatic_role: Big Boss still sometimes helps, making late betrayal stronger.
sequence.player_beat: Land mine advice, visible uniform path, plausible transition.

sequence.event: Bulldozer blocks route to deeper research wing.
sequence.dramatic_role: Machinery is part of working fortress infrastructure.
sequence.player_beat: Moving-vehicle encounter, no personality invented.

sequence.event: Fire Trooper contests a protected passage.
sequence.dramatic_role: The mercenaries' old military skills are revealed through their encounters.
sequence.player_beat: Area-denial warnings, extinguishing/interruption world reaction.

sequence.event: Misleading scientist location leads Snake into a trap; actual Madnar held elsewhere.
sequence.dramatic_role: Not all intelligence is reliable, unlike physical evidence.
sequence.player_beat: Mark false lead source-correlative, no named duplicate Madnar canon.

sequence.event: Freed POWs identify medical staff resistance agent Jennifer; source requires sufficient rank for contact.
sequence.dramatic_role: Rescuing strangers builds enough trust that a hidden insider risks talking.
sequence.player_beat: Preserve 4-star original rank or design a recoverable equivalent after J2ME check.

sequence.event: Jennifer arranges rocket launcher; two TX-11 Arnolds guard Card 7.
sequence.dramatic_role: The engineer's other weapons now impede rescue; medical insider's aid becomes decisive.
sequence.player_beat: Rocket availability/guarded card order, robots not given human feelings.

sequence.event: Snake finds real Madnar. Engineer says his daughter is captive and refuses to discuss Metal Gear until freed.
sequence.dramatic_role: Frustrating to Snake but emotionally justified: father will not risk daughter's life.
sequence.player_beat: Dialogue conditional persisted; no unearned early TX-55 sequence.

sequence.event: Snake deliberately navigates back to Building One through gas, darkness, basement traps and the earlier detention architecture.
sequence.dramatic_role: Backtracking is no longer a chore: Snake revisits the site with a new reason.
sequence.player_beat: Multiple legal return routes; keep hazards and earlier enemy state credible.

sequence.event: Snake hears Ellen through a wall, breaches it and releases her.
sequence.dramatic_role: Two captives rescued from adjacent history of the same facility; visible human cost of engineering project.
sequence.player_beat: Sound/physical clue and rescue flag, separate from Gray Fox's prior cell.

sequence.event: Ellen confirms father was forced to develop the weapon and asks Snake to help him.
sequence.dramatic_role: She is a witness with her own words, not a keycard.
sequence.player_beat: Give Ellen a restrained performance with recoverable transcript.

sequence.event: Snake returns to Madnar, conveys Ellen's safety; engineer gives Metal Gear location in Building Three and destruction method.
sequence.dramatic_role: Moral action unlocks operational truth; no fabricated on-screen family reunion.
sequence.player_beat: Set source-verified rescue dependency after J2ME comparison.

sequence.event: Madnar describes sixteen charges on TX-55 feet in a particular left-right sequence, though the original dialogue omits the last step.
sequence.dramatic_role: His highly specific knowledge is indispensable and still imperfect.
sequence.player_beat: Persistent player-notebook, no mandatory memorization or unskippable lecture.

sequence.event: Return across desert/land crossing to Building Three; truck ambush occurs.
sequence.dramatic_role: The invasion has become a hunt; earlier safe routes are no longer secure.
sequence.player_beat: Enemy placement updates should be source-backed and clearly telegraphed.

sequence.event: Big Boss advises a dangerous truck, then a suspect door during pursuit.
sequence.dramatic_role: The player can now independently catch command in a lie.
sequence.player_beat: Do not force Snake to accept advice; alternative evidence always readable.

sequence.event: Jennifer helps Snake find an oxygen cylinder; underwater link yields access to a previously inaccessible wing.
sequence.dramatic_role: Allies' earlier promises are paid off by new traversability.
sequence.player_beat: Genuine spatial links between buildings, no arbitrary teleport.

sequence.event: Schneider begins identifying fortress commander; transmission cuts off abruptly.
sequence.dramatic_role: The most knowledgeable ally is no longer safe; silence has consequences.
sequence.player_beat: Do not depict death as confirmed.

sequence.event: Coward Duck uses hostages as shield and carries Card 8; Jennifer warns her brother is among captives.
sequence.dramatic_role: Correct target choice and restraint become narrative, not generic combat.
sequence.player_beat: Track hostage survivor state; avoid unavoidable friendly fire.

sequence.event: Snake rescues Jennifer's brother; freed man tells him to choose left ladder to escape.
sequence.dramatic_role: Personal rescue seeds a specific final escape advantage.
sequence.player_beat: Save left-ladder intel independent of whether radio was heard.

sequence.event: Deep bunker prisoner states Big Boss commands Outer Heaven.
sequence.dramatic_role: Disbelief becomes external testimony; the player earned the revelation by rescuing.
sequence.player_beat: Physical witness and persistent transcript, spoiler not telegraphed prematurely.

sequence.event: Big Boss orders Snake to abandon operation and shut down system in original platform-specific style.
sequence.dramatic_role: Authority breaks completely; command no longer defines duty.
sequence.player_beat: Platform-neutral equivalent is a creative decision, preserve intent and shock.

sequence.event: Snake penetrates gas, mines and electrified zones using earned equipment and allies' warnings.
sequence.dramatic_role: Earlier tools and relationships pay off in cumulative mastery.
sequence.player_beat: No equipment-gating traps without fair recoverability.

sequence.event: Snake destroys TX-55 with 16 foot charges; prior Fox and Madnar information directly enables the act.
sequence.dramatic_role: Four arcs converge: missing operative, scientist, hostage and rookie are vindicated.
sequence.player_beat: No added high-health walking tank duel that contradicts original.

sequence.event: Destruction activates alarm and self-destruct countdown.
sequence.dramatic_role: Only now do the fortress and every prior route enter a new state.
sequence.player_beat: Countdown starts after actual TX-55 demolition, not before.

sequence.event: Physical commander claims Big Boss identity and reveals use of Snake to return false data; Diane cannot provide fighting solution.
sequence.dramatic_role: The opening voice becomes personal enemy; later canon's phantom remains a behind-scenes identity.
sequence.player_beat: Preserve 1995 viewpoint and original encounter, no 1984 exposition dump.

sequence.event: Snake defeats commander, follows left ladder clue and escapes; Jennifer's warning adds urgency.
sequence.dramatic_role: Earlier rescue becomes decisive rather than a side quest statistic.
sequence.player_beat: Maintain alternate-safe design only if source allowed; preserve left-ladder canon.

sequence.event: Snake reports Metal Gear destruction and mission completion; fortress explodes; post-credit message threatens future meeting.
sequence.dramatic_role: Rookie becomes self-directed survivor, while command betrayal has an unresolved legacy.
sequence.player_beat: Do not assert precise time/date or complete fates for every rescued person.

narrative_policies: No date/day assumed within mission, except 1995
Do not infer from a 100th basement floor that the above-ground tower is 100 storeys
1987-script locations and texts require comparison against target J2ME edition
One event may be encountered in variable order due to exploration; order defines first-time critical path not a rigid timer
Optional radio cues never gate movement; Jennifer's source-specific gear/door interventions may have actual, recoverable progression conditions
Retain 1995 Snake perspective; Venom identity stays behind-scenes/postgame
known_revisions: Ellen hidden in Building One basement, not Building Three
TX-55 destruction causes self destruct before Big Boss encounter
Jennifer's rocket launcher relationship is rank-gated in original MSX2
Source warns about Big Boss's false truck and door before official identity revelation
Unnamed boss vehicle crews never acquire invented personal biographies
